data.name: Midori Partner
data.description: Midori Climate Partner Pte. Ltd. is a Singapore-based carbon credit developer specializing in biochar carbon removal projects across Southeast Asia, including Cambodia, Thailand, Vietnam, and Malaysia. The company partners with farmer cooperatives and food/wood processing factories to convert biomass waste into biochar for soil application, and closed a pre-seed round led by Tokio Marine Holdings in February 2025.
